correctness.rationale: Ehrhart numerator of an empty tetrahedron equals 1+(m-1)z², yielding an exact dilation formula by finite differences. All facets and edges are primitive/unimodular and Boolean-face inclusion-exclusion yields a,b,a exactly. a>0 and b-2a>0 for m,r>=2, giving three simple real local roots, with one zero. Ordinary r=2 factors into a rational-root linear factor and quadratic with two distinct irrational negative roots; r>=3 is covered by Jochemko. Independent exact enumeration and interpolation passed 124 parameter cases; no finite-to-infinite extrapolation.
